brief: Search for a match using a regular expression
description: Checks whether the regular expression matches anywhere in string value and returns the boolean result. Anchor with ^ and \z to match the whole value.

parameters.description: The regular expression. A regexp literal (/a+b/ or "a+b"re), to_regexp(s), or compile<regexp>(r) is already compiled; any other regexp value is compiled for this call.
parameters.name: regexp
